cars.details: The XC90 Recharge is a plug-in hybrid SUV with advanced safety features and premium comfort.
The XC60 Recharge offers a perfect balance of performance and sustainability with its hybrid engine.
The XC40 Recharge is a compact luxury SUV with cutting-edge electric and hybrid technology.
The XC40 Recharge BEV is a fully electric compact SUV designed for zero emissions and high performance.
The V90 Recharge estate combines elegance and hybrid efficiency for a premium driving experience.
The V60 Recharge is a stylish estate car offering eco-friendly driving with a plug-in hybrid powertrain.
The S90 Recharge luxury sedan delivers a powerful plug-in hybrid system with sophisticated design.
The S60 Recharge offers sporty performance combined with plug-in hybrid efficiency.

trucks.details: The Volvo FH16 is a powerful long-haul truck designed for heavy-duty transport and maximum efficiency.
The Volvo FM Electric is an eco-friendly distribution truck with zero emissions and excellent urban performance.
The Volvo FL Electric is a versatile urban truck designed for quiet, zero-emission city deliveries.
The Volvo VNL is a heavy-duty long-haul truck built for North American highways with superior comfort.
The Volvo VNR is designed for regional haul with enhanced fuel efficiency and driver-focused features.

bus.details: The Volvo 7900 Electric is a modern urban electric bus designed for zero-emission city transport with high passenger capacity.
The Volvo 8900 Electric is an efficient intercity electric bus combining comfort and sustainable transport.
The Volvo 9600 is a reliable diesel-powered intercity bus offering comfort and performance for long-distance travel.
The Volvo BZR is a high-capacity electric articulated bus designed for busy urban routes with zero emissions.
The Gran Arctic 300 is a mega bus built for maximum passenger capacity and long-distance diesel performance.

recentNews.title: Volvo participates in Bahia Farm Show 2025 with brand highlights for agribusiness
recentNews.description: Volvo will be present at another edition of Bahia Farm Show, one of the largest agricultural technology and business fairs in the country, featuring a variety of products for the agricultural sector. The event takes place from June 9 to 14, in Luís Eduardo Magalhães (BA).

recentNews.title: Volvo CE launches its new generation of articulated trucks in Latin America
recentNews.description: Models A45 and A50, recently introduced in Europe, are the first of the new series available in the Latin American continent. The A45 model will be produced in Brazil, at Volvo's factory in Pederneiras (SP). The A50 will be imported from Sweden, where the brand's headquarters is located.

recentNews.title: Construtúnel increases productivity and reduces emissions with Volvo electric machines
recentNews.description: Specialized in precision engineering, the mining construction company uses Volvo electric machines with compact design in tunnel construction. The operation is safer and 300% more efficient.

recentNews.title: Volvo CE presents electromobility solutions for mining at conference in Chile
recentNews.description: The company participates in The Electric Mine, from May 13 to 15, showcasing successful cases in operations in Brazil and Peru. The global commitment to energy efficiency aims to achieve zero CO2 emissions in its products by 2040.
